name: TeamStarWolf - The FireEye Mandiant Intrusion of 2020
description: Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the FireEye Mandiant intrusion of 2020 case study, not an official MITRE mapping. Sources: FireEye's 13 December 2020 SUNBURST technique list, CISA AA20-352A, the ATT&CK SolarWinds Compromise campaign (C0024), Mandiant's and Microsoft's December 2020 and January 2021 identity guidance, CISA AA21-008A and the 2024 SVR advisory AA24-057A. T1098.005 Device Registration for the second-phone alert that exposed the intrusion is the study's own mapping. Group G0016 APT29; campaign C0024. Tactics are taken from data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Scores indicate membership only. Each comment names source numbers from the Sources table of case-studies/MANDIANT_INTRUSION_2020.md.
